props.name: extrasFirst

props.name: menuTail

props.name: panelMenu

props.name: density

props.name: hideHeader

props.name: headEnd

props.name: autoRowHeight
props.description: Row height follows the content (multi-line cells, buttons in rows): the density height is a minimum and the measured height wins; cell text may wrap.

props.name: ruled
props.description: Draw a thin rule between rows.

props.name: selectable
props.description: When false, clicking a row neither selects nor opens it and there is no hover tint; only keyboard movement and expanding remain (for tables of mostly buttons).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Interactive (default true): rows can be clicked, selected and moved with the keyboard, with a context menu.

props.name: stretch
props.description: Treat column widths as proportions: when the container is wider than the sum, the extra space is shared by width ratio; by default widths are fixed pixels.

props.name: fit

props.name: maxHeight

props.name: live

props.name: matchKey

props.name: keysOf

props.name: variant
props.description: Drawing style: area (line with a gradient below, the default), line, baseline (up color above the baseline and down color below), bars, or winloss (Tufte win/loss cells).

props.name: baseline
props.description: Reference value such as the previous close; draws a dashed line, and splits colors in baseline and bars (winloss defaults to 0, bars to the first value).

props.name: lastLabel
props.description: Latest value text shown at the right end, already formatted by the caller; the line leaves room for it.

props.name: showExtremes
props.description: Mark the highest and lowest values with a small dot each.

props.name: extremeLabels
props.description: Texts for the highest and the lowest dots, in that order, already formatted by the caller; placed left or right of the dot to stay inside.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Show a vertical line, a snapped dot and a readout box beside the cursor on hover, and walk the points with the arrow keys; keep it off for one chart per table row.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns a value into its readout text; defaults to the plain number.

props.name: times
props.description: Time of each value, one to one with values: millisecond timestamps place points by time (see domain and sessions), or texts shown under the value in the readout.

props.name: domain
props.description: The whole time span of the x axis in milliseconds (such as a trading day); the line stops at the last point and the rest stays empty.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Trading sessions in milliseconds (such as morning and afternoon); the gaps between them are squeezed out of the x axis and the line breaks there.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Turns a timestamp into the date and time lines of the readout (and the time ticks); written by the caller so language and time zone are its own.

props.name: axis
props.description: Price ticks on the right and time ticks at the bottom, for large charts only (ignored below 60px high).

props.name: lastTag
props.description: Draw the latest value as a filled tag on the right axis, in the up or down color with the matching text color.

props.name: onHover
props.description: Called with the hovered or keyboard-selected index, or null when it leaves.

props.name: volumes
props.description: Volume for each value, drawn as thin bars in the bottom quarter without covering the line.

props.name: volumeTone
props.description: Volume bar color: neutral (default) or follow the price change with the up and down colors.

props.name: curve
props.description: Curve between points: linear (default) or monotone (smooth, never overshooting the data).

props.name: width

props.name: height
